address: via della Chiesa di Gragnano 36, Capannori, 55012, Italy
bio: An entertaining culinary experience, thanks to the Japanese chef who serves his own “fusion” cuisine influenced by Italian dishes (and occasionally European, such as the Basque cheesecake) with the occasional Japanese twist. On Thursdays, the menu is completely Japanese with a focus on typical specialities such as sushi, sashimi, tempura and gyoza dishes....
